## Scope
Actionable SEO plan derived from competitor SERP analysis and sitemap structures.

Raw data: https://github.com/Wladefant/shipnovo/tree/9104135dc7c0bcf8cf2ed6c48fa19fe0a7aeec0d/research/competitors
SERP keyword map: https://github.com/Wladefant/shipnovo/blob/9104135dc7c0bcf8cf2ed6c48fa19fe0a7aeec0d/research/competitors/_serp.md
Other ranking tools: https://github.com/Wladefant/shipnovo/blob/9104135dc7c0bcf8cf2ed6c48fa19fe0a7aeec0d/research/competitors/_others.md

Parent tracker: https://github.com/Wladefant/shipnovo/issues/133

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every page and markup item of the plan is built and live, tracked as sub-issues of this issue (all closed).
- [x] Analyze competitor SERP keyword patterns and landing structures.
- [x] Define Shipnovo target sitemap structure.
- [x] Identify initial 8 high-priority keyword landing pages.

---

### SEO plan for Shipnovo
Pattern seen in the SERP: eBay's own help pages win "eBay Versandetiketten drucken"; small tools win with one dedicated landing page per carrier and per marketplace (SimpleSell, Billbee /versandsoftware/ebay, Shippinglabel /integrationen/ebay); blogs and YouTube fill the how-to gap. Almost no tool has a good page for "eBay Versandetiketten per Handy" or for "Packliste in Label-Reihenfolge".

Sitemap structure (flat, German first, /en later):
- / (home: eBay orders, labels, packing, phone)
- /preise
- /funktionen/ with: versandetiketten-drucken, packliste-sortiert, packmodus-scanner, bestellungen-verwalten, nachrichten-eBay, artikel-lager, mehrere-ebay-konten, app-handy
- /versand/ with: dhl-label-ebay, dhl-paket-etiketten, dpd, gls, hermes, deutsche-post-internetmarke (one page per carrier we support)
- /ebay/ with: versandsoftware, versandetiketten-drucken, bestellungen-verwalten, mehrere-konten
- /vergleich/ with: billbee-alternative, afterbuy-alternative, jtl-shipping-alternative, sendcloud-alternative, ebay-versandetiketten-vs-tool
- /hilfe/ (how-to articles, each with FAQ markup) and /blog/
- /registrieren, /demo

Keyword landing pages to build first (each: H1 = keyword, title under 60 characters, 150-character meta, FAQ block, screenshot, JSON-LD SoftwareApplication plus FAQPage, link to signup):
1. "eBay Versandetiketten drucken" (/ebay/versandetiketten-drucken)
2. "DHL Label eBay" (/versand/dhl-label-ebay)
3. "eBay Versandsoftware" (/ebay/versandsoftware)
4. "eBay Bestellungen verwalten" (/ebay/bestellungen-verwalten)
5. "eBay Packliste drucken" (/funktionen/packliste-sortiert)
6. "eBay Versand App" and "eBay Versandetiketten Handy" (/funktionen/app-handy)
7. "mehrere eBay Konten verwalten" (/ebay/mehrere-konten)
8. Alternative pages: "Billbee Alternative", "Afterbuy Alternative", "JTL Shipping Alternative" (these three have visible price and lock-in anger).
Also: put the price and "monatlich kuendbar, Daten-Export jederzeit" in the first screen of /preise, because lock-in and price rises are the top complaint in the market.
title: SEO plan from competitor research
